Thank you for your patience while those initial labs and images are processed. Since your symptoms of weight loss, night sweats, and abdominal pain are concerning for malignancy or infection, I need to know if you have noticed any new lumps or swelling elsewhere on your body besides the neck?

Also, have you experienced any changes in your appetite or any specific pain patterns, such as pain that worsens after eating or improves when lying on your left side?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma. The combination of painless, fixed supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, B-symptoms (night sweats, weight loss), and abdominal pain is highly suggestive of this malignancy. Please await the results of the CBC, LDH, and your abdominal ultrasound to confirm the extent of involvement before we proceed to a biopsy.
